correctness.rationale: Tran's same-field real matrix theorem supplies the only field-sensitive finite-block input in Liu's zero-diagonal and assembly constructions. The real non-trace-class skew-adjoint case is reduced by a fixed 2x2 similarity whose symmetric part has trace norm 15s/4 on a rotation block of size s; trace-class cases are handled by a real zero-diagonal lemma and the real form of Anderson's construction.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. Liu explicitly proves the theorem only for complex Hilbert spaces, while Tran treats finite matrices. Searches of the current literature and the SCOPE archive found no statement giving the full real infinite-dimensional compact-commutator theorem with universal factor control; older Anderson and Fan-Fong sources remain residual prior-art risks.

value.rationale: The result closes the scalar-field gap in a newly solved classical compact-commutator problem and preserves dimension-free quantitative control. The fixed-conditioning conversion of non-trace-class real skew-adjoint mass into symmetric mass is a reusable mechanism and is not a formal consequence of complexification.
